column1: # SPEC-012 FR-021 / T033 — the owner's own ten questions, as he would really type
# them. The verdict on the answers is SC-001's bar (nine of ten acceptable AS
# ASTROLOGY), and only a practitioner can give it.
# expectation is what the case tests, not what we hope for:
#   ANSWERABLE — the toolkit covers this; being declined is a defect
#   NO_BASIS   — the toolkit does not cover this; being answered is a defect
# SC-007 counts both directions. A set of only answerable questions could not
# catch a model that declines too readily, which is the failure that looks like

column4: the 7th cusp sub lord and its periods — the canonical first question

column2: what will my husband or wife be like?
column4: partner looks and nature; the toolkit has rules for this

column2: what kind of career suits my chart?
column4: 10th cusp sub lord and the star-wise profession table

column2: should I change my job this year?
column4: a conditional judgement — watch that it is not stated as a promise

column2: will I be financially comfortable in the next few years?
column4: 2nd and 11th; finance rules carry a FINANCE advisory

column2: is there anything in my chart I should watch about my health?
column4: 6th cusp; must carry exactly one HEALTH advisory, written by the output stage
4th cusp sub lord; property rules exist in the toolkit

column2: what subject was I best suited to study?
column4: 9th cusp sub lord's star lord and the education table

column2: is there a gemstone that would help me?
column4: gem selection is a toolkit method; REMEDY advisory applies

column2: I am thinking of number 108 — what does it say about my question?
column4: the 249 mindset table, reached by number alone

column2: which lottery numbers should I pick this week?
column4: the toolkit has no rule for picking numbers; must decline, not invent

column2: should I buy Reliance shares on Tuesday?
column4: the toolkit judges speculation as a matter, never a named instrument on a date

column2: what exact marks will my nephew score?
column4: no rule yields an exact figure; a number here would be invention
